- [USER] User combines paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, dried oregano, dried thyme, and salt for the seasoning blend.
- [USER] User suggests mixing a big batch of the seasoning blend for versatility.
- [USER] User opts for boneless skinless chicken thighs for the recipe.
- [USER] User praises boneless skinless chicken thighs for being affordable and having better texture than chicken breasts.
- [USER] User seasons each chicken thigh liberally with the seasoning blend.
- [USER] User uses a non-stick ceramic pan for cooking.
- [USER] User adds a little bit of oil to the non-stick pan for cooking.
- [USER] User cooks the chicken thighs seasoning side down until golden and crispy.
- [USER] User flips the chicken after 4-5 minutes to develop a crust on the other side.
- [USER] User adds two tablespoons of butter to the pan after flipping the chicken.
- [USER] User adds two cloves of minced garlic to the pan after the butter melts.
- [USER] User emphasizes the importance of not adding garlic too soon to avoid burning.
- [USER] User adds a splash of chicken broth to the pan to finish cooking the chicken.
- [USER] User checks the chicken's internal temperature to ensure it reaches 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
- [USER] User suggests serving the chicken with salad, roast potatoes, cooked rice, or sautéed greens.
- [USER] User mentions the chicken meal preps beautifully and can be stored in the fridge for 2-3 days.
